x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change platform-microsoft-365-calendar-and-teams (REQ-M365-001, REQ-M365-004). A meeting declares its dates for OpenRegister's calendar feed, so a member who subscribes once in Outlook or on a phone sees every meeting, moved or cancelled, at the next refresh. teamsMeeting holds the Teams meeting of a digital or hybrid meeting, apart from location so a hybrid meeting keeps the room's address there.
